activity_sentence: Over the last 30 days, daily transactions moved -20% and active accounts -25% against the 30 days before. Whether that is less use or use moving out of sight is exactly what these charts can no longer say.
cost_sentence: Across 2,661 paired accounts and $7.3M, a stablecoin swap cost a median 1.8 bps from entry to exit, and other pairs 77 bps. At the sampled rate, private swappers lose about $224.5K a day between entry and exit, against $60.2K a day reaching NEAR's wallets from every source. Part of that gap is solver spread and price movement. How much is fee, and who keeps it, cannot be seen.
flow_headline: How much of the volume crosses the boundary
flow_intro: Daily boundary flows are still being collected.

provenance_sentence: In the 60 days before 21 September, NEAR kept 2.83 bps of volume. Since then it has kept 5.06 bps. The part with no private trace barely moved, from 1.45 to 1.39 bps. All of the gain left the treasury first: 1.38 to 3.67 bps.
swaps_sentence: In 3 sampled hours before 27 October we saw about 18 private swaps an hour. In 5.7 hours since, about 456. These are only the swaps we can pair, so the true counts are higher.
